captions.detailed: A compact monocular laboratory microscope featuring a dark grey cast base, a curved vertical arm, and a black monocular eyepiece tube angled upwards. It has a round black specimen stage equipped with silver slide clips, situated above a central support pillar. The nosepiece turret holds multiple small objective lenses, and a cylindrical focus knob is mounted on the side of the curved arm.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a monocular laboratory microscope. The assembly must include a dark grey support base, a curved vertical arm with a side-mounted focus knob, a black angled eyepiece tube, a rotating nosepiece turret with multiple objective lenses, and a round specimen stage with slide clips that can adjust fore and aft.
captions.factory: Construct the microscope base using a filleted box primitive, and the central pillar and stage support block using boxes. Create the curved arm by extruding a custom 2D profile along an arc or using boolean subtraction on cylinders. Model the stage as a thin cylinder with small rectangular boxes for the slide clips, and the eyepiece as an angled cylinder. Assemble the objective lenses on a rotating turret cylinder beneath a box-shaped head, and add a cylindrical focus knob on a horizontal axis.
